description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Aphetto Alchemist, adding {U}.
When Aphetto Alchemist dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Aphetto Alchemist from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
